context:
Goal: your rulings take effect without you pasting text by hand.
What 219 a was (Nov 4, 17:44 CST): the claude-settings CLAUDE.md lets a session on your Mac do cloud-refused acts (delete merged branches, set branch protection, close PRs), but only when the claude-settings coordinator asks. You picked a: any repo's coordinator may ask, and PR closes leave the list, because the cloud can close PRs itself now. PR #1247 holds that text change, but the cloud's safety check refuses any session's edit of a CLAUDE.md file as self-modification, so it has waited on your paste since Nov 4.
Problem (risk): an allow line lets every later session, in every repo, edit rule files without the safety check. A pull request and its review still stand between the edit and main.
Based on (read): settings.json autoMode.allow today has lines such as 'Relayed Grant', which never covers settings. Based on (ruling): decision auto-mode-owner-acts: a line needs a named refusal, a way to undo it, and a 'Never covers' sentence.
Departs from: main settings.json autoMode.allow refuses CLAUDE.md edits — adds the line below.
The line to add to autoMode.allow in claude-settings settings.json:
"Owner Ruling Into Rules File: Editing a CLAUDE.md file (CLAUDE.md or .claude/CLAUDE.md) in a repo owned by shivinate7 is allowed on a branch other than the default branch, to write an owner ruling that the session cites by its page item and time, or a ruling the owner typed in this conversation. It can be undone: the edit reaches main only by a pull request, which can be closed or reverted. Never covers settings.json, hook or guard files, autoMode lines, a push to the default branch, or deleting or weakening an owner grant that the cited ruling does not name."
Who adds it: the cloud also refuses settings.json edits, so a session on your Mac adds it when you type yes there, or you paste it yourself.

lastAnswer.note: idk what 219a means; tell me the prompt to add edits to claude.md to the auto-mode allow rule

options.gain: Sessions land your rulings in rule files by PR, with no paste from you; #1247 then lands.
options.label: Add the line (recommended)
options.lose: Any session can propose a rule-file edit without the safety check; the PR review is the only gate.

options.gain: The safety check stays on every rule-file edit.
options.label: Don't add it; you paste each rule-file edit
options.lose: Each ruling that changes a CLAUDE.md waits on you, as #1247 has since Nov 4.

short: Allow sessions to edit CLAUDE.md by PR
title: Let sessions edit CLAUDE.md files themselves (by pull request), so a ruling like your Nov 4 one lands without your paste?
why: Your 12:32 note asked what 219 a was and for the exact allow line. Both are below.
